data.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: completion-verifier evaluated 'wiring' epic SCs as output-based (workflow file exists) rather than outcome-based (workflow actually fires for a downstream sprint). Dual root cause: (a) brainstorm-time SC-authoring gap for 'ship-the-wiring' epics; (b) completion-verifier did not challenge SC measurability for wiring epics. Classification: COMPLEX — requires a brainstorm SC-authoring prompt addition for ship-the-wiring epics, a verifier SC-classification pass that flags output-only SCs as insufficient, and possibly a cross-sprint smoke-test requirement. Also coupled to e21b-1809 (separate bug: Phase E never wired into sprint for epic 4100-95a4). Will become a child story of an upcoming config-consolidation epic per ticket. Leaving OPEN.
